types.description: Person or external agent that uses the system: end user, operator, a program or AI agent acting as a client
The analyzed system as a whole, or an external system it talks to (service, platform, application)
Part of the code with a clear responsibility: module, service, class, struct with behavior, package
Entry point or contract: CLI command, HTTP endpoint, public trait or interface, hook, handler signature, key binding
Named operation or workflow the code performs: use case, pipeline, algorithm, background job (usually a function)
Data structure the system works with: struct, record, DTO, message payload, configuration object, table row
Step that turns data into other data: parsing, mapping, serialization, validation, building a request
Place where data is kept: database, table, file, directory, cache, queue
Message or signal that is emitted and handled: domain event, callback, channel message, hook event, UI event
External library, tool, service or API the system relies on
Way to observe behavior: log line, metric, trace, alert, progress or status output
Way things can go wrong: error condition, timeout, invalid input, missing resource, inconsistency
Source file; added by rekon from the evidence of other elements
Person or team responsible for a part of the system (CODEOWNERS, manifest authors)

relations.description: System or Component -> element it structurally contains (sub-component, module)
Actor or Component -> Interface or Process it starts
Component or Process -> Component, Interface, Process or Dependency it calls
Component -> Process it runs
Interface or Event -> Component or Process that handles it
Component or Process -> DataEntity or Observation it creates
Component or Process -> Event or DataEntity it takes as input
Component or Process -> DataEntity or DataStore it reads
Component or Process -> DataEntity or DataStore it writes
DataTransformation -> DataEntity it takes and turns into another
DataEntity -> DataEntity it is built from (data lineage)
DataEntity -> DataStore where it is kept
Component or Process -> Event it sends
Event, Interface or Process -> Process it starts
System or Component -> Component or Dependency it needs
Interface or Process -> Component that implements it (links to source files are added by rekon)
Process, Component or FailureMode -> Observation that makes it visible
Component or Process -> FailureMode that can happen in it
FailureMode or Event -> FailureMode or Event it leads to
FailureMode -> Component, Process or DataEntity it harms
Element -> Owner responsible for it
